title: Restore editor Reference selection and truthful review feedback
description: As an editor, I can select pending References, inspect actual publication and Section prediction state, approve or reject with optional explanation, and revise persisted feedback through authorized existing APIs. Scope: editor UI and required API integration; no email intake (PPY-65026c), training, production labels, merge or deployment. Reuse existing curation/relevance work. Acceptance: executable Gherkin plus fixture unit/integration/browser coverage of selection, prediction absence/error, optional explanation, persistence, authorization, failure recovery and repeated-click protection.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Implementation complete in isolated branch fix/PPY-f6303b-editor-reference-review. Actual demo layout reproduced a zero-height reference list at 1280x720; collapsed secondary controls restore a 260px viewport with a complete 118px row. Selected references read indexed predictions and latest attached review metadata; errors and missing predictions stay distinct. Review API preserves optional note, rejection reason, explicit Section and decision link; latest server metadata controls human/delegated labels. Added same-status revisions, failure recovery and duplicate-click guards. Verified full lint/typecheck; 22 focused unit/API/auth/schema tests; 5 browser lifecycle/import/rating tests; 9 fixture browser scenarios (34 steps) and real-app layout scenario (3 steps); Python curation 11 scenarios/55 steps and relevance records 9 scenarios/31 steps; pilot guard and diff check. Initial browser executable mismatch resolved with installed Chromium override; import tests updated for new disclosure. Production read-only inspection stops at Editor Sign-In Required, so private predictions and hosted editor mutations remain unverified. Full build compiled but page data failed on /articles/[slug] because demo Amplify outputs lack PublishedItem. No backend/schema/email/training/production changes; no merge or deploy. Draft PR follows.
